reviewer.role: Independent bounded candidate and source-evidence judge
reviewer.basis: Actual separate-agent review of the identified candidate, source pages, context, method, plan and preflight; not a second model-family transcription or whole-verse source audit.

scope: Approve exact v2 bytes for adding literary-form note d, repairing existing a/b/c anchors, changing note a's connective alternative to And Yahweh, synchronizing the opening lexical/conjunction metadata, and archiving stale review states as specified in the bound plan. WLC source and marker-free English remain unchanged.

source_review.finding: The partial unbracketed king/everlasting/anger material in 4Q70 supports presence of verse-10 material; its beginning is supplied and some letters are marked probable. The 4Q71 shorter order and minuses are the edition's spatial reconstruction from line ends, not a surviving complete omission boundary. Candidate accurately preserves both distinctions.

source_review.source: Swete III, third edition (1905), edition scan
source_review.finding: The B continuous text has the content-aligned 5a/9/5b/11 order and no 6-8 or 10. The apparatus continuation explicitly attributes a verse-10 form to Q margin. Introduction identifies Q as Marchalianus and distinguishes marginal matter. Candidate's named witnesses avoid a claim of uniform Greek omission or direct codex-image inspection.

source_review.source: Langlois, Jeremiah redaction history (2019), author-hosted PDF
source_review.finding: The later first-century-BCE dating argument and same-hand/possible-same-scroll assessment are real published reassessments. They are not independently adjudicated here. Candidate makes no exact dating or literary-priority claim.

rubric_assessment.source_fidelity: PASS for bounded disclosure. Published reconstruction, partial survival, continuous Greek text and Greek marginal support are accurately distinguished.
rubric_assessment.balance: PASS. Both shorter and longer evidence appear; retaining the longer form does not become a demonstrated earliest-form preference.
rubric_assessment.placement: PASS. a follows But Yahweh, b true God, c everlasting King, and d the whole verse. These locations match the note subjects and repair the actual baseline defects.
rubric_assessment.connected_metadata: PASS. And Yahweh and But Yahweh accurately describe the unchanged rendering under current divine-name policy; lexical/theological choices no longer incorrectly say LORD. Historical lexicon citations are expressly not newly verified.
rubric_assessment.readability: PASS within scope. Four disclosure sentences are long but intelligible, and their manuscript specificity is useful. Reading 10:3-13 confirms the disclosed literary effect without requiring a prose change.
rubric_assessment.provenance: PASS. Old status, revision_pass and cross_check values are archived with baseline hash and unverified historical input binding. Candidate does not inherit old agreement as approval.

verification.v2_preflight_rerun: PASS; returned object exactly equals saved v2 preflight
verification.baseline_schema_error: Historical status revised is outside schema's draft-only enum; candidate archives it and uses draft.
verification.jeremiah_literary_forms_integrity_check: PASS; 11 context pins and 3 label/ordinal mappings

application_conditions: Apply only the exact approved candidate after rechecking the bound baseline, candidate, plan, preflight and evidence hashes.
Use the separately reviewed scoped transaction and retain its actual before/after and canonical-export receipt.
Record resulting current-corpus/context-pin drift separately; do not rewrite frozen historical evidence to make old checks appear current.
limitations: This approval does not complete source selection or a blind English comparison, and does not certify every retained rationale or the whole verse.
The full modern Gottingen/Hebrew University Bible apparatus and Saley reconstruction remain outside the consulted evidence; priority stays unresolved.
No new manuscript decipherment, visible-letter recovery, physical identity adjudication, independent manuscript count or historical review-input binding is claimed.
Local export checks transport only; actual canonical application and deployed-reader behavior require their own verification.
